item.text: A visually uniform central square can create calm, elegance, and a strong shared identity. Coordinated signs, materials, and colors may highlight historic architecture, reduce visual clutter, and make the area feel welcoming and easy to navigate. This approach can also support tourism by giving the town a recognizable image. However, allowing distinctive shop signs brings energy, personality, and commercial visibility. Individual businesses can express their character, attract attention, and reflect the diversity of local owners and customers. A lively mix of signs may make visitors curious to explore rather than simply pass through. The best choice depends on the town’s values: uniformity suits places seeking harmony and heritage, while variety suits communities that want creativity and independent enterprise.
